veteran.label: Veterans
veteran.ability_desc: Veterans spin for 4s: dodge rolls with i-frames, vortexes down the hall launch all they touch
swap: We've done this before, captain. Stay behind the spin.
That green light isn't natural, captain. We've walked into worse.
Steel moves before you think it. Just point us.
veteran.idle: Veterans hold the center, waiting on your word.

halberdier.label: Halberdiers
halberdier.ability_desc: Every halberdier charges down-range, hitting all it passes for 2x and bulldozing them onto one pile line, then falls back in
swap: Line's up, captain. Give the word and we go through the rank.
Long steel, long reach. Nothing stays standing after.
We charge as one, captain, or we don't charge at all.
halberdier.idle: Halberdiers hold the flanks, reach longer than steel should.

hammer.label: Hammer Knights
swap: Ground shakes when we swing, captain. Stand behind it.
We don't dodge. We break what's standing in front of us.
One good hit and the floor finishes the job.
hammer.idle: Hammer Knights anchor the line, slow and unmovable.

vet_ranged.label: Veteran Ranged
vet_ranged.ability_desc: Backup volley: 4 salvos of 18 arrows slam the box ahead of the hero, 6 each; pierces airborne foes
swap: Arrows are nocked, captain. Just point us at the dark.
Four volleys coming. Make the first one count.
We shoot over your head - try not to duck into it.
vet_ranged.idle: Veteran Ranged loose arrows over the front line.
